name: Card Draw Deck
description: The chance deck on the board: draw when a space says so, reveal to the table, do what the card says, discard face-up. Pile and shuffle mechanics are deliberately not reimplemented here — this component composes inventory.deck_manager in a single-deck, reshuffle-on-empty configuration, because one correct seeded shuffle in the library beats two almost-correct ones. What it adds is the board-game contract: draws are triggered by space effects rather than a turn structure, every draw is public, and declared cards are kept in front of the player instead of discarded until spent. It does not own what card effects do — the effect id is broadcast, and the owning system (economy.currency, movement.token_movement) acts on it. A deck that resolved its own effects would be a rules engine, and this genre already has one too many of those.

inputs.name: cardList
inputs.description: Card ids with their effect ids, in initial deck order before the first shuffle. Required — an empty chance deck is a space that lies to players.

inputs.name: keepableCardIds
inputs.description: Cards held in front of the player instead of discarded (the get-out-of-jail pattern). Kept cards leave the deck's cycle until spent, which the deck manager's pile counts reflect honestly.

inputs.name: reshuffleOnEmpty
inputs.description: Whether the discard pile refreshes an empty deck. False models a deck that is simply gone — rare, but some endgame designs want the well to run dry.

outputs.name: lastDrawnCard
outputs.description: Card id, effect id, and drawing player — public by design, since the table saw it.

outputs.name: heldKeeps
outputs.description: Kept cards and their holders, so the UI can show who is sitting on a reprieve.
